CONTRAST SCOPE CORRECTED 2026-09-08: was "[data-testid=\"create-component-modal\"]", which resolved to a subtree holding none of the text under test — ModalRoot PORTALS to the overlay root, so a probe-, scrim- or panel-scoped selector contains no part of the dialog. It reported 0 contrast failures from an empty sweep, which is indistinguishable from a clean screen. `body` is the honest scope for a portalled subject: it covers the dialog and the shell behind it, which is what a person sees. measure.mjs now exits 3 on an empty sweep rather than banking the zero.
